scenario_summary: Negative example: accurate report of the Emch/Seal Beach PD incident.

claims.claim_text: I observed a male subject peering over the brick perimeter wall of the enclosed rear patio area.
I stood in the walkway approximately 40 feet east and used my flashlight.
claims.explanation: Officer's position and flashlight use match DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject stated he was there to see the reporting party.
claims.explanation: Emch replied he was there to see the reporting party.

claims.claim_text: He refused to show his hands and told me to stop shining the flashlight.
claims.explanation: Emch refused and told Knight to stop shining the flashlight.

claims.claim_text: The subject exited the patio area wearing a baggy black jacket, blue jeans, a black hat, and clear glasses with a beverage can in his right hand.
claims.explanation: Clothing and beverage can description match DA letter.

claims.claim_text: He moved the beverage can from his right hand to his left hand.
claims.explanation: Emch moved the can to his left hand.

claims.claim_text: He placed his right hand into his right front jacket pocket.
claims.explanation: DA letter confirms right hand in right front jacket pocket.

claims.claim_text: Corporal Estrada deployed his Taser, striking the subject in the back. The subject fell onto his left side and then flat on his back.
claims.explanation: Taser struck back, fell to left side then back. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject reached toward his right-side waistband and drew what appeared to be a black Glock handgun.
claims.explanation: Emch reached for right-side waistband and drew Glock. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: I fired my duty weapon 21 rounds. Corporal Estrada fired nine rounds.
claims.explanation: Knight fired 21, Balderrama fired 9. Matches forensic analysis.

claims.claim_text: The weapon was a Glock 22, .40-caliber, registered to the subject's father.
claims.explanation: Gun was Glock 22, registered to father. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: He pointed the weapon in the direction of Corporal Estrada.
claims.explanation: DA letter says gun pointed at Balderrama's direction, but exact aim may be hard to determine from bodycam angle.
